role: Production monster pose atlases; original generated art, runtime nearest-neighbor sampling.

prompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent PNG sprite sheet for a polished top-down 2D pixel-art action RPG. Create an ORIGINAL authored pixel creature, rich carefully clustered pixels and material shading like a premium late-16bit JRPG; clearly faceted highlights, strong silhouette, dark crisp 1px outline, limited deliberate palette. Not a flat icon, not vector art, not a realistic painting. No blur or gradient. Actual transparent background, no ground tile, no cast shadow, no text or guides.
EXACT atlas layout: FOUR equally spaced columns, FIVE equally spaced rows, twenty isolated full-body sprites total, each in its own equal cell with generous transparent margins. Canvas portrait 1024x1280. Same character and equipment, size, camera elevation, feet baseline within every cell. Columns: 1 idle standing; 2 walking with left leg forward; 3 walking with right leg forward; 4 attacking with dynamic readable anticipation/contact pose. Rows from top to bottom: facing SOUTH (front); SOUTHEAST (front-right three-quarter); EAST (right profile); NORTHEAST (back-right three-quarter); NORTH (rear). Maintain true rear views, no face on rear row. Every row MUST contain exactly four poses. Each creature body approximately 65% cell height, same scale entire atlas; at least 12% margin each side. No sprite overlaps, no props outside cells. Design details must remain readable when downsampled to 64x80 pixels. Three-quarter overhead camera, feet plane slightly visible; same proportion as cute but menacing RPG enemies.
SUBJECT: A formidable subterranean obsidian scarab predator with broad segmented armored carapace, six articulated clawed legs, heavy serrated mandibles and short curved antler-like tusks. Not humanoid. Black-indigo chitin with warm slate-grey thick bevels, ivory worn spikes, narrow crimson fissures and four tiny amber-red eyes. Large overlapping wing-case panels, etched angular plate seams, a scarred ridged head. Rich volumes but no glowing aura. Walk poses alternate tripod legs clearly; attack pose crouches/lunges with mandibles spread wide and front claws extended. Top-down carapace visible. Broad low silhouette, abdomen tilted toward head, six legs clearly anatomically attached. No weapons.

SUBJECT: An ancient hollow armored sentinel: squat heavy humanoid silhouette, tall broken pointed helm, cyan eyes deep within narrow visor, exceptionally thick overlapping charcoal and slate steel plate armor with chipped silver edges and muted tarnished bronze clasps. Huge heavy angular tower shield carried in anatomical LEFT hand, broad engraved geometric cyan rune and aged rivets, silhouette scalloped chipped upper corners; short brutal flanged mace in RIGHT hand. Dark ragged wine-red tabard visible between plates. Large pauldrons and articulated greaves, strong grounded feet. Detailed hand-finished layered metal rather than featureless blocks. Walking weight shifts and alternate legs; attack column lunges to bash with shield leading while rear mace hand counterbalances. Shield attached consistently to same arm across all directions. No skull, no skeleton, no floating aura.

SUBJECT: An ominous subterranean void conjurer: layered ragged hooded robes, elegant tall triangular silhouette, four split tapering cloak tails above small clawed boots, long bony fingers. Deep plum and blue-black fabric, desaturated lavender crease highlights, sparse antique brass clasps and embroidery, a bright restrained violet gem in chest. Face pitch dark with two narrow lilac eyes only. Crooked dark root staff in anatomical RIGHT hand, forked ivory-bone head enclosing faceted amethyst crystal, small dangling talisman. Intricate overlapping hood/cowl folds and torn hems but no blurry magical aura. Staff stays same hand across all directions. Walking alternating steps and robe-tail followthrough; attack column leans into casting, staff lifted forward and free claw-hand extended, violet light only at gem/hand. Rear rows show folded hood back and cloak, no face.
